title: Where are the We Are the Tigers/Hadestown fans at? #theatre #broadway
transcript: The way I did not have a show booked tonight. Got out of my matinee and found out that Sydney Parra is gonna be on for your Eurydice tonight. We are heading to the Kerr. Mission accomplished. Got a ticket. $60 in the mezzanine. Let's go. ! It may be an old song, but it never gets old. It never gets old. Aah! What a good show! What a good show! I always love. And a cover goes on in a role, but there's something about, especially when they haven't been on in a while, just how supportive you can see the entire cast is. And Sydney. Incredible. Incredible.
